context: A dad and son chat about hobbies
purpose: Teach: アルゴリズム/ベビー/プリンタ/木々/鳩/泳い/峠/トス

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、新しいゲーム、複雑なアルゴリズムが組まれてるな。
lines.en: Sho, this new game has some pretty complex programming underneath it.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Leaning in with genuine curiosity about what his son is playing. Relaxed posture, the gentle interest of a parent who actually wants to understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!赤ちゃんの妹がベビーカーで一緒に観てくれた。
lines.en: Yeah! My baby sister watched from her stroller the whole time.
lines.style: Bright and earnest, the quiet pride of sharing something with someone he loves. Not performing—just genuine happiness in being included and including her.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 家のプリンタで、攻略本を印刷したぞ。
lines.en: I printed out a strategy guide on the home printer for you.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact delivery with underlying warmth. The kind of practical help that shows he was listening. A soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 休みの日、木々の散歩、楽しいね。
lines.en: The walks through the trees on days off—those are really something, aren't they?
lines.style: Quietly reflective, inviting agreement without pushing. The tone of someone noticing the small good things and wanting to mark them. Slight trailing openness.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 公園の鳩、たくさん集まってたな。
lines.en: There were so many pigeons gathered in the park today.
lines.style: Conversational and observant, almost thinking out loud. The small noticing that parents do—casual, warm, the kind of thing you mention because you were there together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏、プールで泳いで、また写真撮ろう!
lines.en: When summer comes, let's go swimming at the pool again and take some pictures!
lines.style: Immediate energy and excitement. Open, hopeful forward-looking. The rush of a kid imagining something fun just ahead. Not quite breathless, but very present.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 秋、峠まで車で行って、紅葉を見るぞ。
lines.en: In the fall, we'll drive out to the mountain pass and see the autumn leaves.
lines.style: Warm promise in the voice. Not commanding, but gently decisive—a plan being quietly offered as a gift. Settled and sure, the voice of a father making a memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: バレーのトス、もっと練習する。
lines.en: I need to practice my volleyball tosses more.
lines.style: Determined but not grim. The quiet focus of a small person taking his own improvement seriously. Quick, matter-of-fact, the kind of thing he's decided for himself.
